_about: Setup display names (Can, 28 Oct 2026): every setup is named by the reasoning effort its requests sent, checked against the request logs. The databases, league configs, freeze files and URL slugs keep the old names; the site computes with them (bootstrap seeds and slugs come from the old name) and shows the new one. Old names stay as aliases in the data files.

reasoning_notes.LFM2.5-24B-A2B: it has no effort setting. (off): an empty thinking block is prefilled, so it answers without thinking. (on): it is let to think before it answers (its template has no switch or effort setting; the "low" its requests carry is ignored).

_models_about: Model display names (Ümit #4282 item 4): one name per model across the three sites, the name the Logic & Math and Reading bench-scores feeds give the same model (fetched 2026-11-10), with a route suffix where our setup's route differs from theirs. The databases, setups.json, slugs and data ids keep the old model name; every setup named '<old model>' or '<old model> (<setting>)' is shown as '<new model>' / '<new model> (<setting>)'. checks.py fails the build when a page shows an old name.
